deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a patient planeswalker deck built around empowered Jace tokens, shared loyalty abilities, and a growing defensive creature army. The Way enchantments connect life gain, creature deaths, spell copying, and token production into a flexible engine. Win through boosted tokens, repeated draining abilities from Sanctum Lurker, or Jace, Reality Sculptor's library-exiling finish. Develop your mana first, then protect a few productive planeswalkers rather than committing everything at once. The deck favors varied, board-based play over fast combinations, giving up speed and some early consistency to support its demanding four-color costs.

The quality model grades this deck at the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
